_meta.purpose: Exact node definitions applied to the n8n workflow, kept in the repo so the change is reviewable, diffable and re-appliable.
_meta.validation: n8n_validate_workflow (strict): 0 errors, 23 valid connections, 0 invalid connections.
notes: Reference mode is video_prompt_type 'I' (not 'KI'). WanGP drops image_refs unless 'I' is present (wgp.py:1394-1403), and 'K' re-derives the output canvas from reference #1 (wgp.py:7866-7872).
image_prompt_type is always ''. Qwen Image 2.1 declares no image_prompt_types_allowed and its pipeline only consumes input_ref_images (models/qwen21/pipeline.py:209,217).
guidance_scale is NOT sent: /n8n/sync hardcodes it from the model defaults (guidance 4.0, wgp.py:13959 + qwen21_handler.py:150) and ignores custom_settings.guidance_scale.
num_inference_steps: 40 is the documented recommendation for the base model at ~1024px.

chain: Build Image Request -> Wan2GP Qwen 2.1 -> Download Image -> Extract Image -> Upload Image (MinIO) -> Presign Image -> Update Blog Row -> Notify

nodes.name: Wan2GP Qwen 2.1
nodes._leftover: credentials.googleApi is still stored on the node but is inert (authentication: none). The MCP update path cannot send a typed null for `credentials`; clear it in the n8n UI if you want it gone.
nodes._fallbackUrl: https://wan.anagataitsolutions.in/n8n/sync  (use this if the app is only exposed through the reverse proxy)
